protocol.trial_unit: one generated and continuously improved structure
protocol.extension: complete the first 59 trials per count in batches of 8 before issuing remaining fixed series in batches of 32 up to 236; stop selection once the first 59 blocks and an incumbent have evidence; later work is cancelled between stages and drained for shutdown but remains unobserved for selection
protocol.stopping_evidence: 59 aligned count blocks; common final incumbent; latent unpruned block minimum
protocol.calculation_reuse: exact-input memo within this planning call; draws and per-trial budgets unchanged
protocol.input_direction_refinement: omitted optional power step; finite input minimization and task-feedback margin checks retained
protocol.scheduling: round-robin count batches until an incumbent; weight-lower-bound priority within a batch and after an incumbent; fixed count prefixes; distribute screens; collect all completed starts
protocol.generation_scope: task-directed trees, one contact per module; variable-count auxiliary uses the same grammar
protocol.task_contact_count_law: uniform from coarse vertical support count through N; infeasible selected coarse sets end this proposal, not a physical impossibility claim
protocol.contact_assignment_order: task force selects contact set; seam reachability chooses its connection order
protocol.task_contact_selection: normalized task-wrench residual and force-boundary distance; coarse friction 2.25 and 0.5 N normal floor; full material and actuation recheck
protocol.task_pose_initialization: retain generated root, joints and contact targets for continuous surface fitting
protocol.probability_scope: one more trial of this fixed generator; not existence of a better structure

generation_distribution.scope: same mixed-machine generator for the next trial; not a per-machine probability bound

worker_shutdown.method: cancel unobserved work between stages and drain results
worker_shutdown.late_results: not used in selection or evidence

archive.scope: Selection protocol and stopping evidence; detailed candidate rows remain in the local raw output.
